answer_1.quote: Simultaneous speech translation (interpretation) has witnessed a resurgence with the applications of end-to-end encoder-decoder models.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on speech-to-text and speech-to-speech translation outputs, including simultaneous interpretation, which involves natural language generation in target languages.

answer_2.quote: We report ABX discriminability score on the 10s test set from ZeroSpeech 2017 † for English ("En"), French ("Fr") and Mandarin ("Zh").

answer_4.quote: In addition to ASR output, we also collect human transcription on 400 hours of English target speech. The human annotators were asked to provide timestamps for each word while transcribing...
answer_4.guideline: The human annotators were asked to provide timestamps for each word while transcribing, and thus we can apply the same alignment process described above on human transcription and generate a set of ground truth speech-to-speech alignment data.
